query: SELECT mc.characterName, mc.imageUrl, ms.name as setName FROM marvel_cards mc JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id WHERE mc.characterName IN ('Wolverine', 'Doctor Doom', 'Spider-Man', 'Thor', 'Captain America', 'Magneto', 'Cyclops', 'Gambit', 'Loki', 'Doctor Strange', 'Namor', 'Deadpool', 'Mister Fantastic', 'Invisible Woman', 'Human Torch', 'Thing', 'Professor X', 'Storm', 'Black Panther', 'Iron Man') AND (ms.name LIKE '%Comic Book Heroes%' OR ms.name LIKE '%Sapphire%') LIMIT 20;
